description: NaMo₂Mn₂H₃O₁₀ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with six equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-69°. There are two shorter (2.55 Å) and four longer (2.57 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-71°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.85 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-69°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.79 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O atoms. Both H-O bond lengths are 1.23 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Mo and two equivalent Mn atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Mn and two H atoms to form distorted corner-sharing OMn₂H₂ tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Mn atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Mn atom.
